1.consolidated_definition: Pez de agua dulce de hasta 60 cm de longitud, de cuerpo mucilaginoso algo cilíndrico y aletas radiadas; su carne es muy apreciada. Eliotridae, Eleotris guavina.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Freshwater fish reaching up to 24 inches in length, with a mucilaginous body that is somewhat cylindrical and radiated fins; its flesh is highly prized. Family Eliotridae, Eleotris guavina.
